datasheet_identity.title: BAT42WS THRU BAT43WS Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier

extraction_notes: The datasheet is a family sheet for BAT42WS through BAT43WS; the plotted characteristics are labeled as family characteristics and are retained with their Ta, bias, pulsed, and frequency semantics rather than being presented as an unlabeled BAT43WS-only curve.
Plotted points are manual digitizations of visible curve locations from page 2. No unplotted interpolated points were used; plotted values are approximate readings from the axes.

The electrical-characteristics table publishes maximum values except for the BAT43WS VF=2.0 mA minimum and maximum pair; minimum and maximum meanings are preserved in separate forward-voltage entries.
The cathode line denotes the cathode end; reverse-bias conditions therefore specify cathode positive relative to anode.
